# HONGSHENG Auto Parts

## Company

- Chinese name: 衡水宏盛汽车配件有限公司
- English name: Hengshui Hongsheng Auto Parts Co., Ltd.
- Brand: HONGSHENG Auto Parts
- Location: Anping County, Hebei, China
- Established: 1996
- Website: https://www.hsaxle.com/
- Capabilities: OEM/ODM manufacturing, forging, extrusion, CNC machining, heat treatment, quality inspection

## Product categories

- Steering arms and vertical arms
- Control arms, torque rods, and differential assemblies
- Steering knuckles
- Drive shafts and long shaft assemblies
- Agricultural machinery components
- Heavy-duty truck and construction equipment parts

## Product matching guidance

- Use the exact OEM/OE number as the primary lookup key, then verify the vehicle application and product category.
- Product pages expose the English and Chinese product name, OEM/OE references, applications, specifications, images, and an inquiry route.
- OEM numbers are reference data for matching vehicle applications. Confirm dimensions, hole patterns, spline details, and left/right configuration before ordering.
